Students gain global exposure, broadening their perspectives and enhancing their educational experiences. IRO provides a gateway to international opportunities for academic and cultural exchange. Partnerships and Collaborations Mr. Arun Kumar Coordinator The Partnerships and Collaborations Cell focuses on building strategic alliances with institutions and industries. It encourages collaboration on projects, research and internships, creating opportunities for students to network, gain practical experience and expand their professional connections.
